title: Black Benny's expensive funeral and his character
summary: Rene says Black Benny's was the costliest funeral. He describes him as a prize fighter, drummer and one-time bad man who commanded the crowd.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Jazz funerals: dirges, hot return, second line

blocks.x: Well, quite a few things. Yeah, all right. Who had the best funeral? Not necessarily the biggest, but the one where they spent the most money on it, would you say?

Well, the thing I think they spent the most funeral they spent the most money on, I think is, I would say, Black Fitness funeral. He didn't belong to one Nicolette Suits. The reason why I say that, because the fellas hired cars and things, you know what I mean? And they had to pay for the funeral, and a lot of fellas, they laid off from their works and things, put other fellas in place of their work and jobs, just to be in that funeral. And I think that was the most expensive funeral they ever had. Because everybody really just went, he was well-liking, you know? Being a kind of prize fighter too, you know? And then a good drummer, and then he used to be a bad man too, you know, one time. Because when he did settle, get down, you know, to be a real gentleman, he would wear collar and tie. He was a handsome fella too, you know? Nice, tall. Nice looking. But, boy, he would draw a crowd, and they were scared of him too, because he'd get out. We'd be playing shots, he'd stop and go out there with his billets and do it. And the fellas go to fight, he'd go out there and just hit him on the head. Hit on the head, knock him out and come on back and go to play about his business. That's right. That's why today I can't walk straight, I've got to walk right back. That's what I'm doing at the parade, I believe that, I believe that, I'm serious. That's right. I used to have a cigar on my march, you know what I mean? Rad back like that, like that, to go stepping like that. Oh, yeah.
And you're always rad back now.
You're always rad back. Yeah, I just can't walk, just like I walked that way, you know?
